segments.oily: One reviewer with mixed dry/oily patches reports the serum evened out her skin, and another suggests the formula suits oily skin better than dry.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report increased plumpness and relief from flaking, though a few describe the opposite: worsened dryness, tightness, and pilling after use.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it works well without breakouts, including one with sensitive combination skin and a teen with combination skin.
segments.sensitive: Most sensitive-skin reviewers report calm, non-irritating hydration with no breakouts or redness, but a couple describe stinging eyes, redness, or small red dots forming.
segments.mature: Mature-skin reviewers in their 60s-70s frequently report firmer, brighter, smoother-looking skin and reduced fine lines, though one very mature reviewer found it too basic for her hydration needs.
segments.normal: One reviewer with good-condition, dry-leaning skin found it caused flaking and no improvement, offering a rare non-mature normal-skin account.

concerns.aging: Many mature reviewers (60s-70s) report firmer skin, softer look, and reduced fine lines/wrinkles over weeks to months; one very mature user found it 'quite basic' and not plumping enough for her needs.
concerns.dehydration: Numerous reviewers with dry skin report notably improved plumpness and hydration, sometimes eliminating the need for heavier moisturizer; three reviewers report the opposite — increased dryness, tightness, or flaking.
concerns.redness: Some reviewers report reduced redness or that the product soothes rather than irritates; one reviewer with compromised barrier and redness saw no notable change, and another reported new redness and red dots around the eyes.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer reports her skin barrier improved with regular use, no longer needing heavy moisturizer; another with a compromised barrier and redness reported no notable difference after four months.
concerns.spots: Only isolated mentions exist: one reviewer reported a few harmless whiteheads early on that resolved within a week, while most others report no breakouts.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers largely report no new breakouts, including one who called it break-out free even in high humidity; one reviewer noted transient whiteheads that later cleared.
concerns.oiliness: Very little direct comment; one reviewer with mixed oily/dry patches reports more even skin overall, and another suggests the formula may suit oily skin better than dry.

aspects.libelle: Layers well under moisturizer and makeup

extraits.titre: Flakes off - doesn't play well with other skincare
extraits.texte: Grateful I purchased this on sale, I still paid too much and because Ulta's return policy is now only 30 days I'm stuck with it. I have middle age skin that leans dry (thanks, perimenopause!) but is in otherwise very good condition. I've used this product for a solid week by now, and every single time it has caused my skincare to flake off. Like, really badly flake around the hair line, under my chin, around my eyes. I do not find this formula moisturizing. After it dries down, my skin feels just as dry, if not drier, than before. I think this would be a good serum to use alone with microneedling, or if using as skincare it's best suited for those with oily skin. I have seen no improvement in my skin tone or texture, and the flaking, dryness it leaves makes this a hard pass for me.

The product is just OK. Nothing special considering the price. It felt good on and maybe throughout the day, but there were no notable differences in my skin after using for 4 months. With a price point like that, youd expect some sort of change. I would recommend if you have ‚Äúextra‚Äù money but not if you are trying to invest in something that works. For context: I am 32, no acne, some redness due to compromised skin barrier, sensitive skin, no wrinkles, no discoloration.

(29F) I've given this product multiple chances just because of the brand name. My cheeks would get red & small red dots would form around my eyes. It was too harsh for my skin I think. I dont reccomend for senstive or semi young skin.

extraits.titre: Three Stars Solo, Five Stars in a Pair
extraits.texte: Out with the old. I used La Mer for decades, but in my mid-40s, during perimenopause, Ive become more aware of endocrine disruptors in skincare. I was disappointed to learn that, despite its steep price, La Mer is not a clean brand. As someone who has battled hormonal imbalance and fibroids for years, I assumed premium meant safer ingredients - unfortunately, it didnt. Ive since moved to OSEA This isnt the most hydrating/plumping hyaluronic acid Ive used. For very mature skin like mine, it feels quite basic. I need intense plumping and hydration, and this just didnt deliver. The upside is that when I layer it with the Atmosphere Protection Cream in the day and Advanced Protection Cream at night, the results are far better. I think the creams do most of the heavy lifting for moisture. For me, this is a solid three-star product.

I have been using Osea products for about 2 years. This facial serum is the best product I have ever used for my face. I have or had mixed skin with both dry and oily patches, but after using this product I have very even skin, which can be dryer in the colder months where I am from. I use mostly Osea products for my face and when I get a facial they actually praise my skin saying my face really loves my skin care routine. Highly recommended.

I have used the serum virtually every day for more than 5 years and just can't live without it. I always have a back up bottle in my closet so I'm never without it. My skin is extremely dry and sensitive. This ensures that my skin stays hydrated with absolutely no irritation. My no 1 must have!!!

I love this serum! It feels great on my dry sensitive skin, seems to help calm it. Because my skin is dry (and Im older), I often mix it with an oily serum. But my teen daughter with combination skin also loves it now, interestingly.
